paragraphs: Rav Yitzchak bar Ashi said in the name of Rav. See [Pesachim 45b](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.45b.9-11). Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim reads “bar Ashian.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: דק״ס is read contextually as Dikdukei Soferim; Hyman attributes bar Ashian to that source, distinct from heading bar Ashi. This is not an independently inspected Dikdukei Soferim reading.

The linked Gemara and [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2161&lang=en) give the transmission from Rav through Rav Yitzchak bar Ashi. The linked folio cites the same transmission twice.
